cases.name: basic
cases.source:
from Invoice
select InvoiceId, Total

expected.yaml:
format: tugqtree
version: 1
query:
    from:
        name: Invoice
    columns:
        - field: InvoiceId
        - field: Total

cases.name: parameters

expected.yaml:
format: tugqtree
version: 1
parameters:
    - name: CustomerId
      type: integer
      required: true
    - name: MinTotal
      type: decimal
      default: "0"
query:
    from:
        name: Invoice
        alias: i
    where:
        op: ==
        left:
            field: CustomerId
            source: i
        right:
            param: CustomerId
    columns:
        - field: InvoiceId
          source: i
        - field: Total
          source: i

cases.name: scalar-with-cte
cases.source:
from Invoice as i
select (
  i.InvoiceId as ID
  CustomerName as (
    with Customers as (
      from Customer as c
      select c.CustomerId, c.FirstName
    )
    from Customers as c
    where c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId
    select c.FirstName
  )
)

expected.yaml:
format: tugqtree
version: 1
query:
    from:
        name: Invoice
        alias: i
    columns:
        - field: InvoiceId
          source: i
          as: ID
        - query:
            definitions:
                - kind: cte
                  name: Customers
                  query:
                    query:
                        from:
                            name: Customer
                            alias: c
                        columns:
                            - field: CustomerId
                              source: c
                            - field: FirstName
                              source: c
            query:
                from:
                    name: Customers
                    alias: c
                where:
                    op: ==
                    left:
                        field: CustomerId
                        source: c
                    right:
                        field: CustomerId
                        source: i
                columns:
                    - field: FirstName
                      source: c
          as: CustomerName

cases.name: having-count-after-where
cases.source:
parameters (
  @MinInvoices integer default 2
)
from Invoice as i
where i.InvoiceId > 1
group by i.CustomerId
having COUNT(*) >= @MinInvoices
order by i.CustomerId asc
select i.CustomerId, COUNT(*) as InvoiceCount

expected.yaml:
format: tugqtree
version: 1
parameters:
    - name: MinInvoices
      type: integer
      default: 2
query:
    from:
        name: Invoice
        alias: i
    where:
        op: '>'
        left:
            field: InvoiceId
            source: i
        right:
            value: 1
    groupBy:
        - field: CustomerId
          source: i
    having:
        op: '>='
        left:
            aggregate:
                function: COUNT
                args:
                    - star: true
        right:
            param: MinInvoices
    orderBy:
        - field: CustomerId
          source: i
    columns:
        - field: CustomerId
          source: i
        - aggregate:
            function: COUNT
            args:
                - star: true
          as: InvoiceCount
